      'separate, reusable verification primitive that could, in a later and separately-decided step,\n' +
      "become one input to a `WitnessRecord` (see `src/witness/witness.py`'s own docstring for that\n" +
      'schema) — no such bridge exists yet, and none is added here.\n' +

      'leader/validator pair as the general mechanism and prompt-based comparison as a convenience layer\n' +
      'for cases that need one; this contract is exactly the case that does not.\n' +
      '\n' +

      'identical output to the leader" — it cannot distinguish "the validator observed something\n' +

      'malformed leader result before comparing it. `_judge` below is the one deterministic function\n' +

      "invariant checked by `tests/direct/test_provek_evidence_witness.py`'s golden-vector tests); the\n" +
      "validator's job is solely to decide whether it AGREES with the record the leader would write\n" +

      'same URL and computing the identical tuple itself.\n' +

    'independently and agree only if they saw the same thing. Attesting is permissionless; APIbase\n' +

    '\n' +
    'RECEIPT_SCHEMA = "apibase-receipt/1"\n' +
    'SUPPORTED_RAIL = "x402-base"\n' +
    '\n' +

    '_DECIMAL_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9]{1,78}$")\n' +

    '_FETCH_STATES = frozenset({"ok", "error"})\n' +
    '\n' +
    '\n' +
    '@gl.storage.allow\n' +
    '@dataclass\n' +
    'class ChainConfig:\n' +

    '\n' +

    'class Attestation:\n' +
    '    """The published record for one `attest()` call — immutable once written. `result` is\n' +
    '    `PASS`/`FAIL`/`NOT_FOUND`; `observation` is the short reason (`payment_matches`,\n' +
    "    `no_matching_transfer`, `tx_reverted`, `tx_not_found`). The receipt's own fields are copied in\n" +
    '    (already validated and lowercased) so the record stands on its own."""\n' +
    '\n' +
    '    receipt_id: str\n' +
    '    receipt_sha256: str\n' +
    '    rail: str\n' +
    '    chain_id: str\n' +

    '\n' +
    '\n' +
    'def _validate_receipt(doc) -> tuple:\n' +
    '    """Strict shape check of a parsed receipt. Returns `(receipt, None)` with every field\n' +

    '    `(None, key)` naming the FIRST key that is missing or malformed. Pure."""\n' +
    '    if not isinstance(doc, dict):\n' +

    '    if not isinstance(amount, str) or not _DECIMAL_RE.match(amount):\n' +

    '    if not isinstance(doc.get("billed"), bool):\n' +
